channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Advogado de Lulinha critica novo inquérito: "Pesca probatória"
item.description: The lawyer for Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, criticized the opening of a new police investigation against President Lula's son, calling it a 'fishing expedition'. He stated that prior investigations into the INSS scheme found no evidence linking Lulinha to the case and that the new inquiry, authorized by Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça, will examine alleged corruption and influence peddling in the Health Ministry related to medicinal cannabis business.

item.title: Zema acusa Aro de “traição” em Minas
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) accused his former Chief of Staff, Marcelo Aro (PP), of "betrayal" after Aro became the leading right-wing candidate for the 2026 state gubernatorial race. The statement was made in a video released on social media following the withdrawal of Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos) from the election. Zema criticized Aro for leaving his administration and now leading the opposition to his potential re-election.

item.title: Lula se reunirá com Alcolumbre para destravar 6 X 1
item.description: President Lula will meet with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre to advance the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule, a key flag for his 2026 re-election bid. Despite ongoing negotiations, approval before the first round (October 4) is seen as difficult due to tensions stemming from the rejection of Jorge Messias for the STF. The Public Security PEC also remains stalled in the Senate.

item.title: Ao vivo: Flávio faz live após mudanças na comunicação de sua campanha
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) is hosting a YouTube live at 7:30 p.m. this Thursday (July 30, 2026), shortly after his campaign announced staffing changes, including the appointment of publicist Duda Lima as the new communications chief, replacing Alexandre Oltramari and Eduardo Fischer. During the broadcast, he is expected to comment on national politics and answer audience questions.

item.title: Mendonça autoriza investigação contra Lulinha por suspeita de tráfico de influência
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça authorized the opening of an investigation into alleged influence peddling involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, son of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The probe stems from evidence gathered in another case concerning improper INSS discounts, in which Lulinha is already a subject.

item.title: Janaina exalta “predicados” de Tereza Cristina: “Voto de olhos fechados”
item.description: São Paulo city councilwoman Janaina Paschoal praised Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS), stating she has 'all the qualities' to be president of the Republic and that her presence as vice president would 'enhance any ticket'. The statement was made amid rumors that Tereza Cristina could join Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) presidential ticket in the 2026 election.

item.title: Inquérito contra Lulinha é resposta da PF às críticas da oposição e do STF
item.description: The Federal Police opened an inquiry against Fábio Luiz Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, son of President Lula, following opposition and STF criticism over the lack of a specific investigation. Minister André Mendonça authorized the inquiry and was appointed as rapporteur. The probe focuses on alleged influence peddling in the health sector, unrelated to the INSS scandal, after revealing R$19.5 million in bank transactions between 2022 and 2026.

item.title: Cúpula do PP rechaça possibilidade de Tereza Cristina ser vice de Flávio
item.description: The PP leadership rejected the possibility of Tereza Cristina becoming Flávio Bolsonaro's running mate, upholding its decision to remain neutral in the 2026 presidential race. The decision is based on courting the Lula government to secure Ciro Nogueira's re-election in Piauí and avoid complications in other strategic states, along with internal party deadline constraints. Tereza Cristina confirmed she had spoken with Flávio Bolsonaro about the vice presidency but emphasized no decision has been made.

item.title: Zema acusa Aro de traição e critica 'acordos pelas costas' após articulação para disputar o governo de Minas
item.description: Romeu Zema accused Marcelo Aro of betrayal for articulating his candidacy for governor of Minas Gerais with support from PL, Republicans and the Progressista Union federation, denouncing 'backroom deals' as a return of the old politics that harmed the state. Zema stated such movements benefit corrupt politicians and threaten the reconstruction achieved during his mandates, breaking his prior neutrality in the conflict between Aro and Governor Mateus Simões.

item.title: Tereza Cristina se manifesta após conversa com Flávio sobre vice
item.description: Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) stated that 'nothing has been decided' regarding her potential candidacy as vice president on Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) 2026 presidential ticket. She said the topic was discussed for the 'first time' in a meeting with the PL pre-candidate, denying any final decision has been made.

item.title: Mendonça, do STF, autoriza PF a abrir inquérito contra Lulinha
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça authorized the Federal Police to open an investigation against Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), son of President Lula, for alleged corruption and influence peddling tied to medicinal cannabis in the Ministry of Health. The probe stems from the Operation Sem Desconto and includes R$1.5 million in payments from lobbyist Careca do INSS to Roberta Luchsinger, a close associate of Lulinha.

item.title: Tereza Cristina confirma reunião com Flávio, mas diz não haver nada definido sobre vice na chapa
item.description: Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) confirmed a meeting with Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) to discuss joining his presidential ticket as vice president, but stressed that nothing is decided, as the choice requires party approval and political evaluation. She said she would want to be an active 'nosy vice' if selected, not a symbolic figure, and noted the PL has renewed efforts to prevent her from being pushed as a presidential candidate by agribusiness and PP factions. Allies fear the PP may block the deal due to state-level disagreements with the PL.

item.title: Brasil diz à OMC que tarifas dos EUA são discriminatórias e unilaterais
item.description: Brazil filed a complaint at the WTO against the 25% tariffs imposed by the U.S. under the Trump administration, claiming discriminatory, unilateral trade measures that violate WTO rules on non-discrimination, tariff bindings, and prohibitions on unilateral retaliation. The tariffs, stemming from investigations into Brazilian practices in digital commerce, Pix, ethanol access, and illegal deforestation, apply broadly to Brazilian exports. Brazil seeks mandatory consultations as the first step in the WTO dispute settlement process, with potential for a panel and authorized retaliation if no agreement is reached.

item.title: Não estará o senador Cleitinho pensando em 2030, para disputar a Presidência da República?
item.description: Senator Cleitinho Azevedo, despite leading polls for the Minas Gerais governorship, was sidelined by the Republicanos party after missing the state convention, which named another candidate. He publicly reaffirmed his candidacy and claimed to have a ready ticket, sparking speculation that he may be aiming for the presidency in 2030, especially given his growing rift with Republicanos — the party of Tarcísio de Freitas, another potential 2030 contender. Andreazza notes that as a senator, Cleitinho has a clearer path to the presidency than attempting to govern a state with severe fiscal challenges, emphasizing his popularity and deliberate political project.

item.title: Tereza Cristina encontra Flávio Bolsonaro e indica topar vice, mas PP resiste a aliança
item.description: Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) stated she would accept running as vice president on Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL-RJ) 2026 presidential ticket following their meeting on Wednesday. However, the Progressive Party (PP) has resisted the alliance with Bolsonaro’s PL, revealing internal disagreements over supporting the bolsonarist candidacy.

item.title: Paraguai entregará nota de repúdio a embaixador do Brasil na 6ª feira
item.description: The Paraguayan government will deliver a note of repudiation to Brazil's ambassador in Asunción, José Antonio Marcondes de Carvalho, on Friday (July 31, 2026), following statements by President Lula about the Paraguayan War, in which he claimed Brazil was 'invaded' by Paraguayans. Foreign Minister Rubén Ramírez Lezcano confirmed the meeting with Vice President Pedro Alliana and stated that Lula and Paraguayan President Santiago Peña had spoken by phone, though the Brazilian government has not confirmed the call. The Planalto Palace opted not to issue an official response, preferring to preserve bilateral relations through diplomatic channels.

item.title: INSS: PF aciona AGU sobre decisão de André Mendonça contra Lulinha
item.description: The Federal Police has appealed to the AGU to overturn rulings by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça in Operation Sem Desconto, which investiges a billion-dollar fraud scheme at INSS. Mendonça’s rulings require all investigative acts to be filed in his cabinet and any police removals to be pre-notified to the STF. The operation has indicted 48 people, including Lulinha, Lula’s eldest son, alleged to be a hidden partner of 'Careca do INSS'.

item.title: Mendonça autoriza PF a investigar suposto tráfico de influência de Lulinha no governo
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça authorized an investigation into Fabio Luis Lula da Silva, known as 'Lulinha', son of President Lula, for alleged influence peddling and corruption benefiting lobbyist Antônio Carlos Camilo Antunes, alias 'Careca do INSS'. The probe centers on whether Lulinha facilitated meetings at the Ministry of Health to advance cannabis medicine deals tied to Antunes' company, World Cannabis, despite no contracts being finalized. Lulinha's defense calls the inquiry a 'fishing expedition', claiming the PF found no wrongdoing in prior INSS investigations and is now seeking new grounds.

item.title: Missões de observação eleitoral vão acompanhar todas as etapas das Eleições 2026
item.description: Electoral Observation Missions (MOEs) will return for the 2026 General Elections, operating independently and accredited by the TSE to monitor all stages of the electoral process, from preparation and voting to vote counting, totalization, and electronic voting system audits. Composed of national and international organizations, these missions aim to enhance transparency, strengthen public trust, and produce independent reports to improve Brazil’s electoral system.

item.title: Por que a Guerra do Paraguai voltou ao centro de uma crise diplomática — e o dizem historiadores que contestam versão ensinada nas escolas
item.description: President Lula claimed that Paraguay 'decided to invade Brazil' during the Paraguayan War, triggering a diplomatic crisis with Asunción. Historians reject this simplified narrative, arguing the war resulted from complex territorial disputes, regional ambitions, and shifting alliances — not unilateral Paraguayan aggression. The remarks reignited a sensitive historical debate in Paraguay, where the official school-taught version is seen as a nationalist narrative obscuring the shared responsibilities of Brazil, Argentina, and Uruguay in the conflict.

item.title: ‘Eu não sou sabor direita, sou direita raiz’, diz Caiado
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) declares himself 'rooted right-wing' and rejects centrist positioning, aiming to attract Bolsonaro voters to face Lula in a 2026 runoff. His candidacy, with Gilberto Kassab as running mate, signals a clear rightward shift despite PSD’s attempts to remain centrist. Caiado prioritizes defeating the PT and would support any right-wing candidate if he fails to reach the second round.

item.title: TikTok anuncia plano contra desinformação eleitoral
item.description: TikTok announced a plan to counter electoral misinformation for the 2026 elections, hours after the TSE ruled that social media platforms with over 5 million monthly active users must submit compliance plans. The initiative aims to reduce the spread of false content during the electoral period.

item.title: Tereza Cristina admite pela 1ª vez possibilidade de ser vice de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) admitted for the first time the possibility of being Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) vice-presidential running mate after a meeting in Brasília, though she stressed no decision has been made and any alliance depends on political evaluations and party negotiations. The PL is seeking to broaden its support by courting Republicanos and the União Brasil-PP federation, though both have signaled neutrality and granted autonomy to state directories. Other potential vice-presidential candidates include Daniella Marques, Simone Marquetto, and Clarissa Tércio, with any final choice contingent on party approvals.

item.title: PF pede ao STF nova investigação de Lulinha e cita acesso ao gabinete presidencial
item.description: The Federal Police requested the STF to open a new investigation against Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), son of President Lula, for alleged influence peddling and corruption in the medicinal cannabis trade. The PF claims Lulinha worked with entrepreneur Roberta Luchsinger and lobbyist Antônio Camilo Antunes ('Careca do INSS') to secure contracts with the Ministry of Health, allegedly using presidential palace access. Despite case redistribution, the inquiry was reassigned to Minister André Mendonça.

item.title: PF pede ao STF para investigar Lulinha por tráfico de influência
item.description: The Federal Police requested STF authorization to investigate Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), son of President Lula, for alleged influence peddling and corruption in dealings with lobbyist Antonio Carlos Camilo Antunes (Careca do INSS) to favor the approval of medicinal cannabidiol in government programs. The case is now under the rapporteurship of Minister André Mendonça, following distribution on Wednesday (Jul 29), and includes scrutiny of payments from the lobbyist to Roberta Luchsinger’s company and potential transfers to public officials.

item.title: Novo marqueteiro de Flávio Bolsonaro disse há dois meses que não voltaria mais para campanhas
item.description: Duda Lima, recently announced as the new campaign strategist for Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential bid, had stated just over two months ago that he would not return to political campaigns. His appointment marks a reversal of his prior position, raising questions about consistency. The full article is available only to subscribers.

item.title: Atlético-MG oficializa a contratação de Thiago Borbas, ex-Bragantino
item.description: Atlético-MG officially announced the loan signing until the end of 2026, with a purchase option, of Uruguayan forward Thiago Borbas, who was at Real Oviedo (Spain) and belongs to Bragantino. Borbas, 24, was developed by River Plate (Uruguay) and played for Bragantino, scoring 27 goals in 134 appearances. This signing brings Atlético-MG to the maximum limit of nine foreign players allowed in a Brazilian Serie A match.

item.title: Aliados de Tereza Cristina dizem que ela aceita ser vice de Flávio e vai tentar reverter decisão de neutralidade da federação União-PP
item.description: Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) signaled willingness to be Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL-RJ) vice-presidential running mate after initially denying interest. However, the União-PP federation maintains presidential neutrality, though consultations with PP state directories are underway for a possible reversal by August 5. The move is seen as PL pressure, with little expectation of internal PP shift except in a last-minute negotiation scenario.

item.title: André Mendonça autoriza PF a abrir inquérito para apurar tráfico de influência de Lulinha no governo
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça authorized the opening of an inquiry to investigate influence trafficking allegations involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), the eldest son of President Lula. The Federal Police are probing whether he sold access to the federal government in exchange for payments, with ties to the Operation Sem Desconto scheme and businessman 'Careca do INSS'. Lulinha’s defense denies receiving any payments and says they received the news calmly.

item.title: Crises e pressão interna derrubaram marqueteiros de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro replaced marketers Alexandre Oltramari and Eduardo Fischer after internal PL pressure due to poor polling, political crises, and the team’s resistance to integrating Bolsonaro family allies and maintaining dialogue with national leadership. The change, made by mutual agreement, paved the way for Duda Lima — who led Jair Bolsonaro’s 2022 campaign — to take over, despite having previously stated he would not work on 2026 elections.

item.title: Entenda como foi a Guerra do Paraguai citada por Lula
item.description: The Paraguayan War (1864-1870) was the largest and bloodiest armed conflict in South American history, pitting Paraguay against the alliance of Brazil, Argentina, and Uruguay. It resurfaced in public discourse after being cited by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva on July 24, 2026, sparking diplomatic tension with Paraguay. The war caused the death of over half of Paraguay’s population, mostly men, and resulted in the loss of approximately 40% of its national territory.

item.title: Tereza Cristina avisa a aliados que aceitou ser vice de Flávio; definição depende do aval do PP
item.description: Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) told allies she has accepted to run as vice president on Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL-RJ) 2026 presidential ticket. The formal confirmation still requires approval from the Progressive Party (PP), which is part of a federation with União Brasil. The final ticket definition is pending internal PP review.

item.title: Saída de marqueteiros da campanha de Flávio partiu deles
item.description: Journalist Alexandre Oltramari and publicist Eduardo Fisher voluntarily left Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign after expressing dissatisfaction with not being consulted on strategic decisions. Despite maintaining a good relationship with the candidate, they claimed a lack of autonomy in shaping the campaign's marketing strategy. The campaign announced their departure without mentioning their resignation request and confirmed Duda Lima as the new marketing lead.

item.title: Omar Aziz declara R$ 2,07 milhões para disputar o governo do AM
item.description: Senator Omar Aziz, the PSD candidate for governor of Amazonas in 2026, declared R$2.07 million in assets to the TSE, an increase of R$1.08 million from the R$990,100 reported in his previous candidacy. The disclosure was made as part of the 2026 general elections registration. The information was originally published by O Antagonista.

item.title: Juristas e políticos argentinos criticam decreto de Milei e citam o Brasil
item.description: Argentine jurists and politicians criticized President Javier Milei's Decree of Necessity and Urgency, which expands migration restrictions and allows expulsion of foreigners for statements deemed 'hate speech' against Argentines. They highlighted the irony that Milei, due to his public criticism of Brazilian President Lula, could be barred from entering Brazil or Spain if those countries adopted similar measures. The decree also covers acts against national symbols and will be reviewed by Argentina's Congress within 10 business days.

item.title: TikTok apresenta medidas para combate à desinformação durante eleições depois de exigência do TSE
item.description: TikTok announced new measures to combat misinformation during the 2026 elections following a TSE requirement, including partnerships with MonitorA and Agência Lupa for educational videos, improved AI models for violation detection, Trust and Safety structural adjustments, and an Elections Hub with voting guidance and reporting tools. The platform reported 99.8% of misinformation removals were proactive in Q1, and 99.3% of electoral integrity violations were removed before any user report.

item.title: Com empurrão de Tarcísio, Tereza Cristina pode aceitar ser vice de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas brokered an alliance between the Progressistas and Flávio Bolsonaro's PL, convincing Senator Tereza Cristina to accept the vice-presidential candidacy, conditional on the party joining a federation with União Brasil. The move followed unsuccessful attempts by Michel Temer to persuade her. The 2026 election between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro will be decided by undecided voters.

item.title: Augusto Cury sugere chapa única com Zema
item.description: Augusto Cury, pre-candidate for president from the Avante party, stated he called Minas Gerais Governor Romeu Zema (Novo) to propose a single presidential ticket for the 2026 election. In an open letter, Cury said he discussed the possibility of an alliance in the first round, aiming to unite forces against the current political landscape.

item.title: PSD anuncia ex-ministro Aldo Rebelo como coordenador político de campanha de Caiado
item.description: The PSD announced that former minister Aldo Rebelo will serve as the political coordinator for Ronaldo Caiado's presidential campaign in the 2026 elections. The appointment strengthens the party's strategy of leveraging experienced political figures to bolster the ticket. The news was released on Thursday, June 30, at 5:34 PM.

item.title: PT diz que Flávio amplifica rede de perfis anônimos que atacam Lula com IA, e aciona TSE
item.description: The PT filed a complaint with the TSE against Flávio Bolsonaro, alleging he amplified a network of anonymous profiles using AI to attack Lula with coordinated offensive content. The complaint cites 31 profiles with over 1.4 million followers and seeks accountability and individual fines for publications.

item.title: Depois de impasse com DC, Aldo Rebelo vai para campanha de Ronaldo Caiado
item.description: Former minister Aldo Rebelo, following a deadlock with the DC party over his presidential bid, announced he will join Ronaldo Caiado's (PSD) campaign as coordinator. Rebelo, who served in the governments of Dilma Rousseff and Lula, had sought to run for president under the DC but was passed over in favor of former STF minister Joaquim Barbosa, whose candidacy remains unresolved after a legal dispute. Rebelo's decision comes after he spoke at Caiado's convention, where he endorsed a national development project.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio dissocia troca no marketing de polêmicas em convenção
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign states the marketing team change, announced on Thursday, is being dissociated from the controversies that occurred at the presidenciável's convention last weekend.

item.title: Aldo Rebelo assume coordenação política da campanha de Caiado
item.description: Aldo Rebelo, former minister and former president of the Chamber of Deputados, assumed the political coordination of Ronaldo Caiado's 2026 presidential campaign. His appointment follows his controversial expulsion from the DC party, for which he was a pre-candidate, and reflects Caiado's strategy to broaden dialogue across societal sectors. Rebelo had previously spoken at the PSD national convention that formalized Caiado's candidacy, advocating for a national project centered on development, sovereignty, and state planning capacity.

item.title: Dependente do Brasil, Paraguai faz jogo de cena com convocação de embaixador
item.description: Paraguay summoned Brazil's ambassador in Asunción for explanations after President Lulu's comment likening the Paraguayan War to modern defense needs, which was seen as insensitive given the historical trauma. While Lula was factually correct about Solano López's invasion initiating the conflict, Paraguay views the remark as offensive, particularly amid its political alignment with Javier Milei and the Bolsonaro clan. Despite the diplomatic spat, Paraguay remains economically dependent on Brazil, especially in trade and energy from Itaipu Dam.

item.title: Fogo amigo, crise com Michelle e erros na comunicação: por que Flávio trocou novamente o comando da campanha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign replaced its communications leadership again, appointing Duda Lima over Alexandre Oltramari and Eduardo Fischer amid weeks of internal and external criticism. The change followed failures to respond swiftly to crises, such as Michelle Bolsonaro's critical video, and a perception that the team was consistently reactive rather than proactive. PL leaders acknowledged that critiques from Bolsonarist allies, including Fabio Wajngarten and Paulo Figueiredo, had gained traction within the party.

item.title: Planalto evita disputa histórica com Paraguai e aposta em diplomacia
item.description: The Lula administration chose not to publicly respond to Paraguayan criticism over his reference to Paraguay’s invasion of Brazil during the War of the Triple Alliance, opting instead for diplomatic engagement to preserve bilateral relations. Officials assess that while the topic is sensitive in Paraguay, it should not escalate to undermine cooperation, with Lula potentially reaffirming his affection for the Paraguayan people in any future public remarks.

item.title: Falta de ajuste fiscal de presidente eleito ameaça nota do Brasil, diz Moody’s
item.description: Regardless of who wins the 2026 presidential election, the next Brazilian government will face the challenge of building congressional consensus to enact necessary fiscal reforms, according to Moody’s. The agency warns that failure to implement fiscal adjustments could deteriorate Brazil’s fiscal strength, putting pressure on its Ba1 credit rating and stable outlook, with risk of downgrade if no action is taken. William Foster, senior vice president of sovereign risk at Moody’s, emphasizes that distinguishing campaign promises from achievable policies is essential to stabilize debt and preserve public accounts balance.

item.title: As possíveis consequências do vídeo de Jair Bolsonaro feito com IA na convenção do PL, segundo juristas
item.description: Legal experts say the use of an AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro at the PL convention may constitute premature campaigning, potentially leading to fines and a ban on artificial content for Flávio Bolsonaro’s campaign, though they do not expect candidacy cancellation. Bolsonaro’s defense denies authorizing the video, claiming his children have long used his public image without opposition, while noting he is judicially barred from political expression. The TSE will determine if an electoral violation occurred, with possible administrative sanctions but not criminal consequences at this stage.

item.title: Eleições 2026: campanha Boto Fé no Voto quer combater desinformação
item.description: The Boto Fé no Voto campaign, launched at the Anglican Cathedral of Brasília, aims to combat misinformation in faith communities during the 2026 elections. The ecumenical initiative seeks to promote conscious voting, strengthen reliable information circulation, and encourage commitment to truth, involving churches, educators, and communicators in dialogue circles, training sessions, and educational material production.

item.title: Campanha “Boto Fé no Voto” combate fake news nas eleições
item.description: The national campaign "Boto Fé no Voto" will be launched at the Anglican Cathedral of Brasília to combat electoral misinformation, particularly within faith communities. The ecumenical initiative aims to promote reliable information, encourage conscious voting, and strengthen democracy through dialogue circles, educational materials, and digital content under the theme "I choose the truth".
